fields.description:
## Context
Pure mutation plans still need to represent binding lifecycle decisions and prerequisite ordering without performing effects. Selection, filters, mode caps, and safety limits must exclude work before intents are eligible.

## Outcome
Add versioned lifecycle intents and explicit inter-ticket dependencies to `TicketPlan`, and apply every global selection/limit before any lifecycle or remote effect.

## Plan
1. Model bind, confirm, re-key, retire, baseline, and comment-identity changes as versioned intents only.
2. Encode create-before-link and parent-before-child prerequisites. A blocked prerequisite yields deferred disposition and emits no out-of-order mutation.
3. Move selection, filter, mode cap, and global safety limit decisions into pre-effect planning.
4. Cover tombstones, pending/index lag, moved keys, impossible links, partial snapshots, and filtered passes with ticket-sourced tables.

## Impacted sites (existing construction/consumer surface)
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/ticket_plan.py` — `TicketPlan` value type: gains versioned lifecycle-intent and inter-ticket-dependency fields (kept frozen, provider-neutral, open payload).
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/ticket_planner.py` — `plan_pass` (currently groups mutations by target only, ticket_planner.py:110-126): gains intent/dependency derivation and pre-effect selection/filter/mode-cap/limit exclusion. Stays pure (zero I/O).
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/run_differs.py:285` — the shadow construction site `ctx.observation, ctx.ticket_plans = ticket_planner.plan_pass(... selection=..., limits=..., mode=...)`. **In scope:** it adopts the new pre-effect selection/filter/mode-cap/limit behavior and the widened `TicketPlan` surface by calling the updated `plan_pass`; it already forwards `selection`/`limits`/`mode`, so any `plan_pass` signature change is reflected at this call site. It remains a pure, additive shadow attach performing no effects.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_ticket_plan_shadow.py` — held-out oracle extended for intents/dependencies/pre-effect exclusion.

## Testing
Pure tables assert exact intent/dependency/disposition values and poison repository/provider writes. Ordering tests vary each limit independently.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every named binding change is represented as a versioned lifecycle intent.
- [ ] No lifecycle intent performs any write during planning (all repository/provider write seams poisoned).
- [ ] Create-before-link prerequisites are explicit plan dependencies.
- [ ] Parent-before-child prerequisites are explicit plan dependencies.
- [ ] Blocked prerequisites produce deferred plans.
- [ ] Blocked prerequisites emit no out-of-order mutation.
- [ ] Selection, filter, mode cap, and global safety limits exclude work before any intent or remote effect is eligible.
- [ ] Ticket-sourced tombstone, index-lag, move, link, partial-snapshot, and filtered cases have deterministic dispositions.

## Out of scope
Preview output rendering and production coordinator execution. The `run_differs.py:285` shadow construction site is in scope only for adopting the updated `plan_pass` signature/semantics (above); it does not gain preview rendering or effectful execution.
